candidate.user_input: Is a domestic partner's child aged 22 eligible for benefits at GitLab, and how many coaching and therapy sessions are they entitled to as an adult family member?
candidate.reference: A domestic partner's child aged 22 is eligible as an eligible family member up to age 27. As an adult family member (18+), they receive their own full access with 6 coaching and 6 therapy sessions.
reference_contexts:
## Eligibility

- All GitLab team members from day one
- Eligible family members including:
  - Spouse or legal/domestic partner
  - Children up to age 27
  - Partner's children up to age 27

### Family Member Access

- Adult family members (18+) get their own full access with 6 coaching and 6 therapy sessions - [invite them here](https://support.modernhealth.com/hc/en-us/articles/360045577552-How-do-I-invite-my-dependents-)
- Minor family members can access therapy services (with parent/guardian coordination) - [invitation instructions here](https://support.modernhealth.com/hc/en-us/articles/5386344007451-How-do-I-invite-my-minor-dependents-)
- Need help registering? Contact help@joinmodernhealth.com

source_conditions: Eligible family members include partner's children up to age 27
Adult family members (18+) get their own full access with 6 coaching and 6 therapy sessions
